title: Ground-truth validation of the earbuds method for measuring acoustic nasalance
publication: Journal of the Acoustical Society of America 156:851-864 (2024)
manual_provenance: Word- and phone-level WebMAUS segmentations subsequently manually corrected by the author; normalized waveforms manually checked for clipping
modalities: multichannel acoustic; nasometer; oral/nasal earbud channels; manual word/phone intervals; F0; intensity; nasalance
notes: One 41-year-old male native speaker; 3 texts x 3 repetitions x 2 earbud placements x 2 nasometer placements = 36 readings. Article reports 28,524 observations with nasometer in place, including 15,667 voiced and 12,857 unvoiced. OSF public data/code deposit is authoritative; enumerate files before observation ingest.
